items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Chew Barry, I‟m glad you mentioned the name because Chew Barry is responsible for that... Chew Barry‟s a swing saver, a swapper. So he would meet Chick Webb up on the corner... Chew Barry finally got to Benny Carter

ctx.x: He really was one of the leaders in those days who would really pay for an arrangement. He wanted good arrangements and he wanted guys who could write for Chew Barry, whoever would happen to be in the band.
Yeah. Well I‟ve got to tell you a story about that. Chew Barry, I‟m glad you mentioned the name because Chew Barry is responsible for that.
